title: ASTM C 636, Section 2.
officialText:
7.5. Add Section 2.7.5 to read as follows:
2.7.5 The construction documents shall show the necessary details of the acoustical ceiling to identify the number, size, spacing,
location, weights, and types of fixtures and means employed to comply with these requirements.
